statements.subject: dccp
statements.description: Therefore, DCCP implementations SHOULD use the following, more stringent checks for active connections, where a connection is considered active if it has received valid packets from the other endpoint within the last three round-trip times.
statements.post_cond: packet.sequence_valid = (SWL <= seqno & seqno <= SWH & AWL <= ackno & ackno <= AWH)
actions: Apply stringent Sequence Number check SWL <= seqno <= SWH for DCCP-Sync and DCCP-SyncAck
Apply stringent Acknowledgement Number check AWL <= ackno <= AWH for DCCP-Sync and DCCP-SyncAck

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Finally, an endpoint MAY apply the following more stringent checks to DCCP-CloseReq, DCCP-Close, and DCCP-Reset packets, further lowering the probability of successful blind attacks using those packet types.
statements.trigger: DCCP-CloseReq or DCCP-Close or DCCP-Reset received
statements.post_cond: packet.sequence_valid = (seqno = GSR + 1 & GAR <= ackno & ackno <= AWH)
actions: Apply stringent Sequence Number check seqno == GSR + 1 for DCCP-CloseReq, DCCP-Close, DCCP-Reset
Apply stringent Acknowledgement Number check GAR <= ackno <= AWH for DCCP-CloseReq, DCCP-Close, DCCP-Reset
